tei:div.tei:p: )zangs mdog dpal ri'i smon lam bzhugs so// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum 'phags tshogs nyan thos dang*// byang chub sems dpa' rig 'dzin lha dang bcas// mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho dgongs// 'dir gshegs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa mi dge bshags// dus gsum dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang*// chos 'khor bla na med pa bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i don la bzhugs// ma gyur dge tshogs theg pa chen por bsngo*// dmigs bcas dmigs med zung 'jug mchog thob shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing khams 'di nas lho nub pad+ma 'od// pad+ma 'byung gnas 'gro ba'i mgon po yi// ye shes thugs rje'i brtse bas bdag skyong nas// tshe 'dir bde legs bkra shis mchog thob shog /'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor skye ngan las ngan dang*// sdug bsngal mi shes 'chi rkyen ngan pa'i rigs// mi 'byung 'chi ba lam la ro snyoms shing*// 'od gsal 'pho ba'i ngang du gshegs par shog /shi ma thag tu bar do ngo shes nas// chos nyid sa la gtan srid zin pa dang*// 'od gsal snang ba bzhi la gdeng thob cing*// gzhon nu bum pa sku yi zhing khams su// lhun grub 'pho ba chen po'i sku thob shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lus 'di bor nas lho nub rnga yab gling*// gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po mchog /zangs mdog dpal ri pad+ma 'od phung du// pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs drung skye bar shog /skye ba pad+ma'i sbubs su 'khrungs pa dang*// 'khrungs ma thag tu phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis// khrus gsol dbang bskur rigs kyi ming gnang nas// bkra shis lha mos na bza' gsol bar shog /shar gling rdo rje'i khrus rdzing thang chen du// lha mos khrus gsol rgyan dang rtse ba yi// rol rtsed sna tshogs dga' bde longs spyod cing*// lha mi las 'das spyod pa skyong bar shog /lho gling longs spyod tshogs la mnga' brnyes shing*// rgyan dang nor mchog mang po sbyin pa dang*// mi zad 'dod dgus bdag gzhan re bkang cing*// sbyin pa chen po'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog

/nub phyogs dbang gi gnas su dbang thob cing*// dbang chen rta mgrin yab yum zhal mthong nas// sbyor sgrol gnas dag dbang chen sku thob cing*// tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa'i sku thob shog /byang phyogs drag po'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas// longs sku bde ba mchog gi sku thob nas// gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs chen po mchog /gang 'dul sprul pa bye ba sa ya yis// brtson 'grus chen po'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /zangs mdog ri bo tsit+ta 'bar ba'i dbyibs// phyi gling bcu gnyis nang gling brgyad kyis bskor// gling khams srin po gdul byar bkod pa dang*// smin grol mthar phyin 'brel tshad don ldan shog /gdul bya dag dang ma dag las sna tshogs// srin po gdug pa'i tshogs kyi dug lnga rnams// thabs kyis 'dul zhing thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis// sems can thams cad bde ba'i lam 'god pa'i// bzod pa chen po'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /skyed mos tshal dang dur khrod sa dbyibs dang*// o rgyan gnas dang mkha' 'gro dpa' bo'i gling*// zhing dang 'phrul zhing kun la dbang bsgyur nas// bsam gtan chen po'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang bla na med// sgo bzhi them skas rwa ba chen po dang*// lcags ri zlum skor 'obs lcags rim bdun sogs// rim zhugs theg pa mchog la phyin par shog /'od gsal tshad med gzhal yas khang klong du// pad+ma 'byung gnas sa bcu'i mgon po nyid// shes rab chen po'i mig gis mthong ba dang*// shes rab chen po'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /pad 'byung zhal gyi bdud rtsi ngas lon nas// theg pa mchog dang bla med lam nod cing*// thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su 'grub pa dang*// ye shes chen po'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rje 'bangs grub chen dang*// gsang sngags lha dang bla ma chen po yi// go 'phang mchog gi sa la 'god pa dang*// stobs kyi pha rol phyin pa'i sa thob shog

/gsang sngags mos pa'i dkyil 'khor 'grub pa dang*// theg pa mtha' yas chos sgo phye ba dang*// gsang sngags bla med smin grol mthar phyin nas// thabs kyi mchog gi pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sku ni mi 'gyur pad 'byung sku thob cing*// gsung ni mi 'gag pad+ma'i ljags thob cing*// thugs ni 'khrul med pad 'byung mchog 'grub cing*// smon lam chen po'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /yon tan bye ba phrag brgya 'gyed pa dang*// phrin las rnam bzhis gang 'dul der sprul zhing*// khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa dang*// lam lnga bla med mchog tu bsgrod par shog /sa bcu'i zhing mchog pad+ma 'od de ru// 'gro ba'i bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// gnyis med sku gsung thugs su sangs rgyas nas// ye shes bla ma'i sa la 'god par shog /bla ma pad 'byung khyed sku ci 'dra dang*// 'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams sogs// khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba// de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog// /
